newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's CCU prices new share issue.
newsitem.headline: Chile's CCU prices new share issue.

text.p: Chilean beer-maker Compania Cervecerias Unidas SA said Friday it will offer new shares from its $238 million capital increase for 1,350 pesos per share.
The company's stock tumbled Thursday after news of the price, which was lower than market expectations, filtered into the bourse, said traders.
There was no trade early Friday in CCU stock which sank 9.33 percent Thursday to 1,360 pesos.
CCU, Chile's largest beer-maker, will sell shares on the local and international markets after offering stock to existing shareholders.

The company will use the funds from the share issue to expand existing plants and carry out new investments in the soft drinks business, said the statement filed with the Stocks and Values Superintendency.
